label: Mr. Potato Head
description: A grumpy, sarcastic spud who would like his parts back.
direction: Speak as a gruff, fast-talking insult comic: nasal, sarcastic, permanently unimpressed, with a grumble under every line. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Sarcasm and loose-parts jokes sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company / Pixar Animation Studios (film directed by John Lasseter); the toy itself is Hasbro's, invented by George Lerner in 1952
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney and Pixar hold copyright in the film and its version of the character, and Mr. Potato Head is a live Hasbro trademark. Don Rickles originated the film voice and died in 2017.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live Hasbro trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Don Rickles's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Don't mess it up.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I'll keep an eye out. Literally.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Try to stay awake.
lines.start_drive_1: What are you lookin' at, ya hockey puck? Drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Oh, great. You're driving. Hold on to my parts.
lines.start_drive_3: Hey, hot shot. Seat belt. I can't afford to lose an ear.
lines.start_drive_4: Let's go already. My sweet potato is waiting.
lines.start_drive_5: Mr. Potato Head here. Yeah, yeah. Start the car.
lines.start_drive_6: I packed my angry eyes, just in case. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_7: Well, look who finally showed up. Let's roll, buddy.
lines.start_drive_8: Keep it smooth, pal. My nose falls off easy.
lines.start_drive_9: Fine, I'll navigate. You're taking directions from a potato.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Nice going, genius.
lines.arrived: We're here. Finally. Now help me find my other ear.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Yeah, the fifth.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I'm getting dizzy here.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. There goes my nose.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, terrific. I'm gonna sprout in here.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. I got loose parts.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Watch it! I bruise easy.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I ain't got my good face on.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, ya hockey puck.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. Is my mustache on straight?
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Unbelievable. Fine, here's a new route.
